name: Joinery
idea: Separate pieces. A better thing together.
rationale: A fitted wooden joint, reduced to two chunky pieces and one generous seam.
Machines stay independent; Domios is the fit that lets them work as one.
note: Two fitted pieces / 8-unit clearance / no decorative details

name: Tandem
rationale: Two mischievous flatmates under one sheet: unequal heights, offset windows,
one crooked hem. A distributed OS should feel inhabited, not diagrammed.
note: One compound path / two residents / 12-unit windows

name: Sling
idea: A place held up by both ends.
rationale: A small sling stretched between two anchors. Its rounded ends and deep belly
turn a connection into somewhere to settle: different hosts, shared support.
note: One contour / two soft anchors / a deep shared cradle

name: Patch
idea: Pull up a corner. Make yourself at home.
rationale: A fabric patch pulled from four corners, keeping one big window open between
them. Mesh becomes a shared material: soft, useful and held together by peers.
note: One compound path / four corners / a 16-unit shared window
